projects.name: Parano1d Pool
projects.description: Public address-based mining pool for Parano1d workers.

projects.name: PeakPool
projects.description: Self-hosted Stratum V2 solo pool with a full node and direct block payouts.

projects.name: InnovLab Pool
projects.description: Public NOID mining pool with live network, miner, block and payout statistics.

projects.name: Suprnova
projects.description: Public PPLNS NOID mining pool with a 1% fee, live statistics and plain or TLS Stratum endpoints.

projects.name: RPlant
projects.description: Public NOID mining pool with a 1% fee, hourly payouts, regional Stratum endpoints, TLS and live statistics.

projects.name: AlphaPool
projects.description: Independent public NOID mining pool with PROP and SOLO modes (1% fee each), automatic payouts and Stratum endpoints in the US, Europe, Asia and Russia.

projects.name: GB Parano1d Solo
projects.description: Self-hosted Stratum V1 solo pool in one Docker container with a bundled Parano1d node, for Linux and Windows; found blocks pay the operator's own address.

projects.name: Rabid Pool
projects.description: Public PPLNS NOID mining pool with a 1% pool fee, Stratum access and six-hour payouts from 1 NOID.

projects.name: LuckyPool
projects.description: Public NOID mining pool with regional Stratum endpoints, a 1% fee, proportional rewards and two-hour payouts from 1 NOID.

projects.name: Hashborn NOID Miner
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS.

projects.name: noid-gpu-miner
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS.

projects.name: PeakMiner
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for public pool and self-hosted solo NOID mining on Windows, Linux and HiveOS.

projects.name: INVminer
projects.description: Binary CPU and NVIDIA GPU miner for InnovLab Pool on Linux and HiveOS.

projects.name: NTMminer NOID
projects.description: Binary CPU and NVIDIA GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS with published checksums, built-in consensus self-tests and a 3% developer fee.

projects.name: GB Miner
projects.description: NVIDIA GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS, with HTTP and Stratum support, pool failover and per-card power controls.
projects.notes: Supports GTX 900/10/16, RTX 20/30/40/50, Volta and selected Tesla cards. The published NOID developer fee is 2%. Driver requirements vary by GPU family.

projects.name: ForgeMiner
projects.description: NVIDIA and AMD GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS, with multi-pool failover, device controls and published checksums.

projects.name: NOID GPU Miner for AMD
projects.description: Binary AMD GPU miner for Windows, Linux and HiveOS via HIP, ROCm or OpenCL, with a disclosed 5% fee. Only RX 9070 has been tested; Linux builds have not been run on AMD hardware.

projects.name: Fl4shMiner
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for Windows and HiveOS with NOID/Poseidon2b support and a disclosed 3% developer fee.

projects.name: Suprminer
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for NOID on Windows, Linux and modern HiveOS with no developer fee on the NOID algorithm.

projects.name: OneZeroMiner
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA GPU miner for NOID/Poseidon2b on Windows, Linux and HiveOS, with a disclosed 1% NOID developer fee.

projects.name: SRBMiner-Multi
projects.description: Binary NVIDIA and AMD GPU miner for NOID on Windows, Linux and HiveOS, with a disclosed 2% developer fee.

projects.name: Gozero Assistant
projects.description: Open-source Windows NOID mining assistant using Suprminer or Fl4shMiner, with hardware monitoring, pool controls and a floating monitor. Beta software with a disclosed 0.5% mining-time service fee.

projects.name: NoidMiner
projects.description: Open-source NVIDIA Pascal miner for Windows and Linux with no developer fee and InnovLab pool support. The Linux build has not yet been tested on GPU by its author.

projects.name: NOID Miner for Apple Silicon
projects.description: Experimental open-source Apple Silicon miner with CPU, Metal GPU and combined modes, a SwiftUI interface and InnovLab support. No developer fee; macOS 13 or newer.

projects.name: SafeTrade
projects.description: Centralized exchange with live NOID/USDT spot trading.

projects.name: Parano1d Explorer
projects.description: Read-only community explorer for blocks, transactions, addresses, UTXOs and network data.

projects.name: NOID Explorer
projects.description: Community block explorer for blocks, transactions, addresses, mempool, rich list, network economics and historical data.

projects.name: NOID Mempool Explorer
projects.description: Community mempool and mining explorer with pending transactions, fee-rate visualizations, a mining calculator and observed network statistics.

projects.name: Gozero NOID Explorer
projects.description: Community explorer for Parano1d blocks, recorded transactions, confirmed address balances, network data and mining pools, with partial history coverage.

projects.name: MiningChamp
projects.description: Independent NOID mining pool directory with network statistics, pool hashrates and Stratum connection details.

projects.name: PowMonkey
projects.description: Independent emission research covering NOID issuance, fund allocations and unlock schedules, with linked source records.

projects.name: CoinGecko
projects.description: NOID market tracker with price charts, trading volume, exchange listings and market data.

projects.name: WhatToMine
projects.description: NOID mining profitability calculator with Poseidon2b network statistics, block rewards and exchange rates.

projects.name: CoinPaprika
projects.description: NOID market tracker with price history, trading volume, charts and exchange data.

projects.name: Ethereum Research
projects.description: Architecture post and technical discussion of a live end-to-end PQ proof-native protocol.

projects.name: Poseidon2b on Ethereum Research
projects.description: Technical discussion of published algebraic attacks against Parano1d's production Poseidon2b parameters.

projects.name: Cryptography mailing list
projects.description: Technical introduction to the working proof-carrying State system over binary fields.

projects.name: Programmable rights on Cryptography
projects.description: Mailing-list post on programmable spending rights in recursively proved live State.

projects.name: Bitcointalk
projects.description: Main public announcement thread and ongoing network discussion.

projects.name: Noidium
projects.description: Parano1d analytics and on-chain trading platform with token markets, an NFT marketplace and archived chain data.

projects.name: Octonoid
projects.description: Community platform with a Parano1d explorer, token market, holder analytics and an NFT portal.

projects.name: Octonoid Tracker Bot
projects.description: Telegram bot for Parano1d token buy alerts and on-chain market activity.

projects.name: Parano1d NAV
projects.description: Community ecosystem directory with a live network dashboard, recent blocks and network trends.

projects.name: NOIDSCAN Pocket Watch
projects.description: Live Parano1d block clock presented as an interactive pocket watch.

projects.name: Parano1d MCP
projects.description: Open-source MCP server connecting AI clients to a local Parano1d node, with typed RPC tools and read-only access by default.
projects.notes: Pre-release. The author supports read-only deployment. Write and admin modes are opt-in. Contract and native writes were exercised on a private test network.

projects.name: NOID GPU Node
projects.description: Community Parano1d v2.1 node build with CUDA-accelerated proof generation and CPU fallback.
projects.notes: Experimental Linux build for the Small, Large and Native proof classes. NVIDIA CUDA hardware accelerates proof generation. Hashing workers can connect separately through the mining RPC.

projects.name: GB Parano1d Permanode
projects.description: Open-source archive service that captures Parano1d block bodies into SQLite and exposes a JSON API.
projects.notes: Retains block bodies observed while the service is running. History missed during downtime depends on the source node retaining those bodies.

projects.name: RigeOS
projects.description: Mining fleet console for managing rigs, monitoring hardware and configuring mining workloads.

projects.name: GB Poseidon2b Dual Miner
projects.description: NVIDIA GPU miner that runs NOID alongside a second supported mining workload, with per-device tuning and monitoring.

projects.name: FreeForGem
projects.description: NVIDIA GPU miner with NOID support, per-GPU tuning, monitoring and Windows, Linux and HiveOS packages.
projects.notes: The author publishes host-side Rust code. NOID mining kernels remain proprietary, so this listing is classified as closed source.

projects.name: KRminer
projects.description: NVIDIA GPU miner with NOID support, pool failover and Windows, Linux and HiveOS packages.

projects.name: WildRig NG
projects.description: GPU miner with NOID support for NVIDIA Volta and newer cards and AMD RDNA 1 to 4 GPUs.

projects.name: HashPulse
projects.description: Multi-coin miner with a CPU backend for Parano1d Poseidon2b and Windows and Linux binaries.

projects.name: X-Miner
projects.description: Open-source NVIDIA and AMD GPU miner for Parano1d, with per-device tuning and Windows and Linux builds.
projects.notes: Includes a HiveOS custom-miner package. The author states that this package has not yet been tested on a HiveOS rig.

projects.name: GB Pool
projects.description: Public Parano1d mining pool with PPLNS rewards, regional connection endpoints and per-worker statistics.

projects.name: PQPool
projects.description: Public NOID mining pool with worker, block and payout statistics.

projects.name: HimPool
projects.description: Public NOID mining pool with proportional, solo and solo loyalty reward modes.

projects.name: TazMining
projects.description: Public PPLNS Parano1d mining pool with Stratum access, hourly payouts and pool statistics.
